sys_atf_test.description: Inserts pending Community Tips (type Drop and type Listing) with a collectible and store, updates status to approved, and asserts the "Create Record from Approved Tip" business rule links a new Drop (name = tip title, status upcoming for a future suggested date) or a new Store Listing (availability in_stock, listing URL copied from source link).
sys_atf_test.name: CollectNow - Approving a tip creates a Drop or Store Listing
sys_atf_test.sys_name: CollectNow - Approving a tip creates a Drop or Store Listing

sys_atf_test.description: Asserts the collector Scripted REST API (service_id=collector) is active with its 4 routes, then runs the same context queries for collectible COL0001006 (previous sales, live/upcoming drops, listings) to confirm the data EmployeeWorks consumes is retrievable.
sys_atf_test.name: CollectNow - Collector Context API is installed and returns data
sys_atf_test.sys_name: CollectNow - Collector Context API returns a collectible context

sys_atf_test.description: Exercises the createWatch logic the POST /watch endpoint uses: resolves collectible by number COL0001006, inserts a Watch for the current user, asserts a WCH-prefixed number and the collector is set, then cleans up the test record.
sys_atf_test.name: CollectNow - Collector watch creation logic
sys_atf_test.sys_name: CollectNow - Collector Context API creates a watch

sys_atf_test.description: Inserts Drops with future, live and past date windows and asserts the "Set Drop Status from Dates" business rule sets status to upcoming, live or past (including the no-end-date = release + 1 day case), and that each Drop gets an auto number. Then updates an upcoming Drop into a live window to cover the update path.
sys_atf_test.name: CollectNow - Drop status is derived from dates
sys_atf_test.sys_name: CollectNow - Drop status is derived from dates

sys_atf_test.description: Inserts a Collectible then a Previous Sale referencing it and asserts the Sale record receives a non-empty auto-generated number (SAL prefix), verifying table auto-numbering.
sys_atf_test.name: CollectNow - Previous Sale gets an auto number
sys_atf_test.sys_name: CollectNow - Previous Sale gets an auto number

sys_atf_test.description: Negative side of "Create Record from Approved Tip": tries to approve tips missing a store, missing a tip type, and a Drop tip missing a suggested date, and asserts each update is aborted and the tip stays pending with no linked record. Also rejects a complete tip and asserts no Drop is created (condition only fires on approved).
sys_atf_test.name: CollectNow - Tip approval is blocked when required data is missing
sys_atf_test.sys_name: CollectNow - Tip approval is blocked when required data is missing

sys_atf_test.description: Inserts a Collectible then a Watch referencing it and asserts the Watch record receives a non-empty auto-generated number (WCH prefix), verifying table auto-numbering.
sys_atf_test.name: CollectNow - Watch gets an auto number
sys_atf_test.sys_name: CollectNow - Watch gets an auto number
